description: This script checks if the current Node.js version meets the minimum required version for Vite (>=20.19.0). It compares the installed Node.js version with the minimum version, outputs an error message if the requirement is not met, and exits with code 1. If the requirement is satisfied, it exits normally without output.

methods.name: versionCompare
methods.description: Compares two version arrays (e.g., [20,19,0]) and returns 1 if the first is greater, -1 if less, and 0 if equal.
